ul.li: Comments: Type “Supplementary unemployment benefit information received from the client.”

step.cmd: Determine if the client meets all criteria to be eligible to SUB plan:
In NWS, create a ROD as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “The [type of SUB payments] are not considered earnings.”
Details: Type “The [type of SUB payments] received by the client are not earnings as defined in EIR 37(1). No allocation is required.”

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if there is a MA01 imposed for the SUB issue:

ul.li:
If no, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction and complete it as follows:
SUB: Enter the SUB code.
Select Update .
Go to step 19.

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction and complete it as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the applicable registration number.
Manual Action: Select 1 - General Suspension of Benefits (stop payment) .

Complete: Select the appropriate option:
To complete the registration number, select C - Yes .
To leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions, select D - No .

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if there is an MA01 imposed for the SUB issue:

ul.li:
If no, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction and complete it as follows to indicate that the SUB is not registered or does not meet the conditions of EIR 37:
SUB: Select 09 .
Select Update .
If the SUB plan is payable due to incapacity, refer to step 8 of Allocating incapacity monies . Allocating incapacity monies
If the SUB plan is payable due to shortage of work or due to training, refer to step 8 of Allocating other monies . Allocating other monies

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal / Revised (M106) transaction and enter the code as follows to indicate that the SUB plan is not registered or does not meet the conditions of EIR 37:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Manual Action: Select 1 - General suspension of benefits (stop payment) .

Complete: Select the appropriate option:
To complete the registration number, C - Yes .
To leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions, D - No .
If the SUB plan is payable due to incapacity, refer to step 8 of Allocating incapacity monies . Allocating incapacity monies
If the SUB plan is payable due to shortage of work or training, refer to step 8 of Allocating other monies . Allocating other monies
